summary: Both patches identically relabel point 13105 from driveable_surface to car. The shared angular-range comparison E3 supports replacement: the target is 0.154 m short of the fitted road intersection and continues into nearby car-labeled returns 0.279–0.366 m short, while flanking road returns differ by at most about 0.022 m. E2 shows a stable 3.1 cm elevation above the road, consistent with a low grazing edge but also a limitation; S0 favors road and the images do not independently establish ownership. This new range-profile measurement supports car more than planar road continuity. Reused S0/LiDAR, the proposal box and unconfirmed T0 association alone were insufficient. Choose TRACK_TO_SEG:0; TRACK_TO_SEG:1 has the same executable label effect.
